note: NFR-4.16 shipped default: official/upstream namespaces the seeded products and the platform itself pull from. `docker.io/orangehrm` is absent on purpose — upstream publishes no image, so that namespace could only ever supply a third party's build under the product's own name, which is exactly what a deployment pulled when the locally built image was missing; the render set builds into `ghcr.io/seamnex` instead. The database revision is authoritative once one exists; this document is only the starting point.
